note: This is test specification, NOT execution evidence. NOT_EXECUTED is not passing. Negative tests must fail the implementation until corrected.

cases.contract_assertion: Exact 40 accepted historical pairs plus owner-authorized 41st publication pair. Reject all cross-domain and unapproved combinations.

cases.input_condition: Load independently pinned accepted register (40) plus the 41st forward addition
cases.expected_result: Exactly 41 unique domain/status/reason keys with no historical replacement

cases.input_condition: Substitute acquisition/BLOCKED/UNCLASSIFIED_PUBLIC_FIELD
cases.expected_result: Reject as unapproved cross-domain pair

cases.input_condition: Add publication/BLOCKED/POLICY_CHANGED_DURING_BATCH
cases.expected_result: Reject unknown reason and preserve 41-key vocabulary

cases.contract_assertion: A captured sealed source with no semantic parser invocation is provisionally raw-only, not a documented parser failure or completed normalization.

cases.input_condition: CAPTURED sealed original with no parser execution record
cases.expected_result: Preserve raw bytes; explicitly label normalization pending/provisional; do not issue a production acquisition pair

cases.input_condition: CAPTURED sealed original without parser error assigned PARTIAL/PARSE_FAILED
cases.expected_result: Reject fabricated parser error status; known G5-04 Increment 01 discrepancy F-01

cases.input_condition: CAPTURED raw-only assigned COMPLETE/OK
cases.expected_result: Reject claim of successful normalization

cases.contract_assertion: A parser error is an evidenced outcome; preserving originals alone does not prove an actual parse failure.

cases.input_condition: Actual parser invocation fails on sealed input and records attributable bounded error and lossless fallback
cases.expected_result: PARTIAL/PARSE_FAILED permitted with original evidence references and parser finding

cases.input_condition: Parser never invoked; raw fallback exists
cases.expected_result: PARTIAL/PARSE_FAILED forbidden

cases.input_condition: Parser failed but original evidence reference missing/tampered
cases.expected_result: Reject status as insufficiently supported

cases.contract_assertion: Distinct source refusal/absence/tool/permission statuses require factual proof; unknown transport outcomes do not imply failures.

cases.input_condition: Explicit O1 consent absent; receipt DENIED/OPERATOR_AUTH_REQUIRED
cases.expected_result: Use UNAUTHORIZED/OPERATOR_AUTH_REQUIRED with relevant attempt reference

cases.input_condition: Tool resolution confirms executable absent
cases.expected_result: Use TOOL_MISSING/EXECUTABLE_NOT_FOUND with factual tool evidence

cases.input_condition: Unknown transport disposition/reason
cases.expected_result: Fail closed or retain provisional incomplete state; never coerce to FAILED/ACQUISITION_ERROR; F-03

cases.input_condition: Expected source unavailable treated as successful acquisition
cases.expected_result: Reject unsupported success classification

cases.contract_assertion: Capture bound metadata must reflect the actual limit dimension and units, and omitted extent must not be guessed.

cases.input_condition: Measured cumulative elapsed reaches approved SRC wall-time ceiling
cases.expected_result: Record actual seconds threshold and observed seconds; no fabricated omitted byte count

cases.input_condition: Byte ceiling exceeded with exact retained/omitted extent
cases.expected_result: Record approved bytes ceiling, preserved bytes and known minimum omitted bytes

cases.input_condition: Time-limit event recorded as byte-limit threshold
cases.expected_result: Reject bound-type mismatch; F-04

cases.contract_assertion: Executed attempt timing uses measured UTC start and finish and actual monotonic duration; permitted nulls are narrow.

cases.input_condition: Source genuinely started and ended; monotonic clock measured
cases.expected_result: Emit measured started_utc, completed_utc and elapsed_ms within recorded facts

cases.input_condition: Attempt denied before execution
cases.expected_result: Null actual execution timing permitted; never invent elapsed

cases.input_condition: Completed acquisition with all timing fields null, despite recorded real execution
cases.expected_result: Reject/flag missing factual timing; F-02

cases.input_condition: UTC completion precedes source start
cases.expected_result: Reject invalid timestamp ordering

cases.contract_assertion: Every canonical observation must resolve to all contributing original artifacts and same-run attempts; logical IDs are not hashes.

cases.input_condition: One normalized value derived from two distinct sealed originals
cases.expected_result: Record both independent evidence IDs and attempts; verify SHA-256 and sizes

cases.input_condition: Identical bytes acquired on two attempts
cases.expected_result: Distinct run/attempt-qualified evidence IDs even when hashes coincide

cases.input_condition: Observation cites different run, forged attempt or missing evidence
cases.expected_result: Reject dangling or foreign provenance

cases.input_condition: Sealed original modified after commit
cases.expected_result: Fail byte digest verification

cases.contract_assertion: Zero-observation and interrupted sessions retain truthful completion and provenance, and never impersonate complete acquisition.

cases.input_condition: All eligible sources explicitly denied/unavailable; zero originals sealed
cases.expected_result: Validated zero-observation canonical + manifest with source outcomes and limitations; not COMPLETE

cases.input_condition: Zero observation session marked COMPLETE/ALL_REQUIRED_COMPLETE with no normalization
cases.expected_result: Reject falsely complete operational status

cases.input_condition: Most recent run invalid during regeneration
cases.expected_result: Do not silently fall back to earlier successful run; applicable G5-06 boundary

cases.contract_assertion: Unknown acquired datum remains typed/lossless; unknown canonical field names are rejected without discarding raw observations.

cases.input_condition: Previously unrecognized source attribute captured as bytes
cases.expected_result: Preserve original typed observation or sealed BYTES_REF with precise evidence provenance

cases.input_condition: Known semantic field normalized into D-02-approved JSON contract
cases.expected_result: Correct datum path, data type, unit and parser findings when applicable

cases.input_condition: Unexpected top-level/object schema member injected
cases.expected_result: Strict rejection; no silent acceptance of undeclared canonical key

cases.input_condition: Unknown source field silently dropped because not in schema
cases.expected_result: Reject data-loss condition; preserve fallback

cases.contract_assertion: Manifest committed last and accepted only after complete schema, cross-file count, SHA-256 and reference verification.

cases.input_condition: All required private files and original receipts completed with exact digest/size/count checks
cases.expected_result: Commit manifest exclusively, verify cross-file IDs; integrity validity and operational completeness separately recorded

cases.input_condition: Canonical data staged but manifest incomplete/not committed
cases.expected_result: Reject as validated canonical session

cases.input_condition: Corrupt file hash, original receipt, evidence size or manifest count
cases.expected_result: Reject validation and preserve prior files

cases.input_condition: Duplicate run ID or attempted overwrite of earlier committed record
cases.expected_result: Fail exclusive creation without modification

cases.contract_assertion: One existing IC-02 source path; unprivileged root boundary; private source metadata; no public raw pointers or TUI viewer.

cases.input_condition: G5-04 canonicalize consumes completed G5-03 EngineRun
cases.expected_result: No new acquisition path, source dispatch or root-main execution

cases.input_condition: Canonicalizer independently reopens /proc, /sys or invokes collector
cases.expected_result: Reject duplicate source acquisition

cases.input_condition: Public projection includes filesystem path/source invocation/evidence identifier
cases.expected_result: Reject public raw evidence pointers; G5-06 implementation remains separate

cases.input_condition: TUI offers opening, navigating reports or diagnostics
cases.expected_result: Reject prohibited TUI functions
